coordination_variable.name: r
coordination_variable.interpretation: positive prefers relative hip progress; negative prefers relative knee progress
coordination_variable.phase_semantics: OUTBOUND increases s; RETURN decreases s on the same endpoint-consistent coordination path using the same r

notes: The five profiles are test conditions on a continuous controller input, not a discrete action vocabulary.
A profile has one path parameter r and RETURN reverses the same path by decreasing s.

The gain is the largest checked simple value below the first observed geometric penetration: gain 0.25 keeps all five preregistered paths non-penetrating, while 0.30 does not. This is candidate-path calibration, not a new safety threshold.
Cuff-force metrics are observational and are not used to select or rank profiles.
